observed_vs_expected: The pre-declared expectation that best_target_score should rise or remain stable was directly contradicted: the score dropped sharply from 0.934208579741109 (Round 2) to 0.7823508899327729 (Round 3), representing a negative deviation of -0.1518576900083361. This aligns partially with the fallback clause ('If the hypothesis is wrong, best_target_score may plateau early or valid_candidates may drop'), though valid_candidates remained consistent with expectations at 9 (>=5 threshold) and tightest_margin held stable at 0.43522061339779616 without significant fall.
deviation_mechanism: The enforced 2 nm perturbation window artificially truncated the optical path-length adjustment bandwidth required for thin-film interference tuning. Constructive/destructive switching in multilayer stacks typically requires quarter-wavelength phase shifts (~50–100 nm for NIR bands). By capping per-round thickness deltas at ±2 nm, the optimizer became trapped within a single interference phase basin. Hard spectral margins remained satisfied (tightest_margin=0.435), but the restricted search volume prevented resolution of passband ripple and impedance matching errors, causing the aggregate objective penalty to spike and the global score to collapse.
continue_rationale: The sharp score decline signals algorithmic trapping rather than physical convergence or constraint exhaustion. Design feasibility is explicitly preserved with valid_candidates=9 and tightest_margin=0.43522061339779616. Continuing is mandatory to test whether restoring exploration bandwidth breaks the phase-lock, recovers the Round 2 peak (0.934208579741109), and validates whether the route possesses residual optimization capacity.
insight_for_next: Revert the global perturbation amplitude from 2 nm to 5 nm to regain sufficient phase-tuning degrees of freedom. Decouple asymmetric refinement weights on layers 3 and 6 by applying uniform initialization weights across all 24 layers. Inject a 'phase-jump' repair step: randomly select 10% of the population and apply stochastic thickness offsets of ±50 nm to forcibly cross local interference minima before resuming gradient-based refinement.
insight_grounding: The strategic pivot is grounded in the measured best_target_score collapse from 0.934208579741109 (Round 2) to 0.7823508899327729 (Round 3) under the strict perturbation schedule. Constraint health is verified by tightest_margin 0.43522061339779616 and valid_candidates 9, proving feasibility is intact while thickness adjustment bandwidth was artificially removed.
